reason: The hypothesis makes specific claims about oxide film disruption, accelerated corrosion, and synergistic degradation in HEAs under tribo-corrosion, but no prior evidence is cited to support any of these premises. Standard textbook knowledge covers general tribo-corrosion concepts, but the application to HEAs and the specific mechanistic feedback loop require supporting evidence, which is absent.
premises: Mechanical wear disrupts the protective oxide film on HEAs
Disrupted oxide film exposes fresh metal that accelerates corrosion
Corrosion weakens the material and enhances wear
Synergistic interaction leads to degradation exceeding the sum of separate wear and corrosion
